I expanded the full establish-then-retract lifecycle — the calibration narrative and position (establishment side), the retraction narrative and position (disavowal side), the actor Xena ExpertGH who voices both sides, and all seven witness-depth expressions — so the passes can recognize the pattern and create parallel structures for the new zeppelin/helium subject rather than minting duplicates.
